name: Water Slide Vr
summary:
Water Slide VR  is a fast-paced arcade racing game where players compete on giant waterslides  sliding down to reach the Island and finish first.

Use Hand Gestures to active abilities to over come obstacle, boost speed  and take shortcuts.

🛝 Race down massive twisting waterslides.
🏁 Beat AI opponents | Friends | Network Player  to the finish line Or  Race against time to beat won best time.
✂️ Take risky shortcuts by jumping off the slide , gliding throught the air and landing further ahead.
💥 Bump opp
